title: Built-in Tools Test Harness: Deferred Suites
description:
Follow-up from Batch 3 signoff. Complete deferred test harness items from docs/plans/06-built-in-tools-test-harness.md.

Deferred items (7):
- P3: Backend parity (LocalBackend vs SandboxBackend — requires sandbox env)
- S2: Callback event ordering for long-running bash (requires sandbox streaming)
- SEC3: Secret redaction in tool outputs/logging
- O2: Differential grep oracle (pure-Go vs rg reference comparison)
- B5: Bash callback forwarding overhead benchmark (<3% wall-time)
- ST1: 12-hour mixed-tool soak test (requires CI soak runner)
- ST2: High-fanout grep stress test

These were deferred because they depend on Batch 4 infrastructure (sandbox env, CI soak runners).

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
